text:
Taylor Hall has played 999 NHL games, and the next one, if he dresses, comes in the Global Series in Finland against Seattle. NHL.com's Tracey Myers called it the perfect time for the milestone. The first pick of 2010 has been a Hart Trophy winner, a journeyman across seven teams, and, per his awards, a Stanley Cup champion with Carolina last season.

He has only played ten games this year after missing most of late October and early November (RotoWire and Yahoo Sports tracked the injury), and he is back in a depth role at about 13 minutes a night. Those minutes have been excellent: Carolina has 67% of expected goals with him on the ice at 5v5, almost ten points better than without him.

Some context belongs with that. Evolving-Hockey notes he plays with strong teammates, which flatters raw on-ice numbers, though they still rated his own play-driving in the 91st percentile last season. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the best setup men in the league (92nd percentile in primary shot assists). He still makes the next play. Watch whether his ice time climbs now that he is healthy.
headline: Taylor Hall's 1,000th game is headed to Finland
